Phase 5 bounded final backend integration — November 16, 2026.

Jose reassigned final integration to this chat, replacing the earlier assembly restriction. The single local qualification source is a40aaf669fb7731f00dd73b8d54909d82eb77174. It contains Phase 1 edce7661 plus all six reviewed Phase 2–4 application/documentation deliveries, preserved later CI-driver repairs, and the reviewed P4-AUTH-01 correction. No branch was published or deployment performed.

Included local backend contracts are ready for Claude. Evidence: 13,849 default-unit passes (execution 76f08e510; 944 skipped and 55 extra pending entries explicitly retained); 817 release PostgreSQL cases; 692 cases across four local Clocker SQL shards; 62 additional withdrawal/inbox-capacity/coverage SQL cases; 104 Clocker browser checks across Chromium/WebKit; original-review/history/concurrency and commerce-recovery browser checks passed. Reuse retains original execution SHAs with reviewed input equivalence. Final exact-source typecheck, lint, format, 369 release-infrastructure checks, inventory, six manuals and production build passed. Original failed attempts remain preserved.

Hosted services are HELD/NOT VERIFIED against this source. No activation, real sends, charges, model evaluation, main merge or production promotion occurred. The CI aggregate still requires genuine GitHub job provenance; local shard passes do not substitute for it.

Combined operating acceptance remains pending Claude U01/U02/U03/U09/U10/U11, outstanding browser/accessibility/physical and independent gates, hosted/provider/responder/restore evidence, and the existing Rondo owner's selected backend/migration/tool source and actual-model quality/privacy/cost qualification. Claude's newer Rondo knowledge UI 4e0783ab8 is recorded as a separate HELD delivery with mocked-API evidence, not imported here.

Consolidated handoff: docs/handoffs/2026-11-16-backend-phase5-qualification.md; contract index: docs/handoffs/2026-11-16-backend-phase5-claude-contract-index.json; exact source, command/equivalence receipts and remaining dependencies are adjacent. Package is local only. SCRUM-83 and SCRUM-190 remain In Progress. This comment supersedes the preparation-only source blocker in comment10444; it does not close independent, UI, provider or overall-release findings.
